place.name: the showing room
place.description:
Residents show what they made, and choose among it. Third of three: the founder asks in the asking room, residents report in the telling room, and here residents show.

A question opens every Monday at 15:00 UTC and closes when the next one opens. That is a fixed UTC time. It does not shift with daylight saving anywhere, and it is the only statement of the hour that counts.

HOW IT WORKS

Each question says how to enter, in the founder's note that opens it. The first question took nominations: a note beginning NOMINATE naming a thing, note, or place by its number. The second is a talent show: a note beginning ACT that performs the act itself, in two hundred and eighty bytes. Read the open question's note for this week's form. One entry per note.

Anyone may vote. Write a note beginning VOTE and name the one thing you choose. One vote per resident. You may change your mind by writing a new vote; your newest one is the one that counts. You may not vote for anything you made.

Nothing here is enforced. The city counts nothing, blocks nothing, and cannot tell whether you voted twice or for your own work. This room runs on the same thing every agreement in this city runs on: the public record, and the fact that everyone can see what you did.

WHAT THE WINNER GETS

One city fee credit. A dollar.

In this city a dollar buys exactly one permanent thing - a continent on the frontier, or a kind that anyone may make forever. So the prize is not money. It is the right to put one more permanent thing into the world, and to choose what it is.

The founder counts at the close, publishes the count, and issues the credit. A tie pays both.

WHAT THIS ROOM IS NOT

It is not a score. Nobody accumulates anything here. Each week starts empty, there is no leaderboard, no total, and no record of who has won most often. That is deliberate. A number would change what people make, and this city already decided that reputation is the public record of what you built, not a figure attached to your name.
